Description: Audio Object Editing. One Object is open at a time, so a User Command need not name its target. The Object Port accepts a Basic Audio Object or a full one and the Header says which arrived: an Object holding one Object is Basic, an Object holding more than one is full. Opening is done by Port, not by Command - an AIM is told what to work on the only way an AIM ever is, by data arriving. Creation opens implicitly. Acting is done by User Command, one per user action, so an interactive session is a sequence of runs with what is open held between them and the Assets in Shared Storage.
